product_metadata.title: EC VISION Wooden Alarm Clocks, Silent Desk Clock Elephant Digital Alarm Clock with Cell phone Stand and Night Light for Kids, Bedrooms, Home, Dormitory, Travel
features: 💕Universal Cell Phone Stand - The wooden clock compatitble with cell phone stand function which use for all kind of Smartphone. The nose of the elephant is long, it turns upward and becomes a space. In your free time, put you phone on the stand and watch a movie enjoy a leisurely time or put the phone on it before going to bed.

💕Exclusive design - The main body of the alarm clock's material is wood, shows typical stripe and wood texture, making it natural and simple, bringing you a healthy and fashionable low-carbon life. The dial is made of PVC which is damp-proof with no worry of fading or out of shape. The pointer is made of Aluminum with fine texture and a stable shape.

💕Super Quiet Clock - Perfect for child use as bedroom clock, silent and won't disturb her sleep. Accurate quartz movement, silent, no ticking to ensure a good sleep. Requires 1 AA batteries (batteries not included).

💕Night Light Function- This silent alarm clock inside with nightlight and ultra large letter that don't get up turn on the light, just press the top button can lets you see the time in dark clearly. The soft lighting will not make your eyes uncomfortable.

💕User-friendly Alarm Function- The cute alarm clock volume increases gradually, never let you wake up too suddenly. The snooze button provides 10 chances of snooze , letting you no worry of oversleeping.
description: Material: natural wood Weight: 356 g Clock accuracy: average month difference within ± 30 seconds (at normal temperature use) Alarm accuracy: ± 5 minutes (for the set time) Operating temperature range: -10 ° C to + 50 ° C Power Source: AA size dry battery x 1 (manganese battery)

- Our Alarm Clock combines durable material with an elaborate craftsmanship, offering an ideal quality for you.  - The distinctive design of the wooden shell shows typical stripe and wood texture, making it natural and simple. The Alarm Clock is a tasteful decoration at home, adding leisure and warmth to your life.  - The dial is made of PVC which is damp-proof and no worry of fading or out of shape.The pointer is made of Aluminum with fine texture and a stable shape. - The movement is noiseless, promising you a silent night. - The little night light inside of the Alarm Clock lets you see the time in dark. The soft lighting will not make your eyes uncomfortable.  - The snooze button provides 10 chances of snooze , letting you no worry of oversleeping. - The Alarm Clock volume increases gradually, never let you wake up too suddenly.
